name: Main Street Cafe
notes: No restaurant-owned website (work item lists website: null). Uber Eats listing for this restaurant has been 'Closed on Uber Eats as of Aug 18, 2023' and shows every dish with NO price at all, so it was unusable. Instead used Yelp's photo tab (NOT the barred menu tab) - dated, reviewer-posted photographs of the physical laminated menu, uploaded Jul 12, 2025 by reviewer Marcel E. (recent and dated, per the rule that a dated-and-recent in-store photo beats an undated aggregator page). Photo lightbox rendered black under contention, so full-resolution image URLs were pulled from the DOM with JS and fetched directly as .../bphoto/<id>/o.jpg. Multiple photos of the same physical pages (re-photographed by different reviewers) were cross-read to confirm every price. COMPLETE: omelettes, egg combos/benedicts/burritos, sizzlin' skillets, pancakes/waffles/french toast, salads, sandwiches, wraps, burgers, soup, a la carte sides, dessert, and drinks are all captured from the physical menu. One item (Reuben sandwich) had no legible price in any photo and was omitted rather than guessed.
